name: How do property management fees typically work in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: How do property management fees typically work in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: In South Florida, property management fees generally consist of a percentage of the monthly rent collected, often ranging from 8% to 12%. Some agreements may include an initial setup fee, leasing commissions for new tenants, or fees for specific services like eviction management or extensive repairs. When considering a property manager, compare their fee structure against the services provided to ensure it aligns with your financial goals and the level of involvement you desire as an owner.
acceptedAnswer.description: Property management fees in South Florida typically range from 8% to 12% of monthly rent, with potential additional charges for specific services.
